notes.title: Community Update – Development Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941746/44db07481d5a58c1516288e86707b05a5e501c0f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Dear pioneers,[/p][p]
today we’d like to share a first image from the current stage of development. It gives you an impression of what we’re working on right now and how the project is progressing step by step.[/p][p]
Over the coming weeks, we’ll release more visual sneak peeks so you can follow the progress directly. In addition, we’re planning to share early gameplay scenes. This will allow us to gather your feedback at an early stage and align development more closely with the community.[/p][p]
Stay tuned, we’ll keep you updated on a regular basis.[/p][p]

— The G.E.T. Team[/p]

notes.title: Community Update – What’s Been Going On & What’s Next
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941746/13287e419b3b52841618dc738eecb562db3607c8.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear pioneers, 

since our last post, we’ve been busy behind the scenes. We took a deep dive into the current state of G.E.T. and carefully reviewed everything you shared with us during the demo. Every bug report, every piece of feedback, and every suggestion was logged and discussed. These insights are now the backbone of our work on the Alpha. At the same time, we’ve mapped out a clear roadmap for what’s essential in the next stage of development. We’ve identified five core systems that will define the Alpha and set the stage for the full game.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Age Progression System[/b][/u] [/h3][p]Progressing through ages is more than just “unlocking the next tier.”[/p][list][*][p]Each new era comes with meaningful tasks[/p][/*][*][p]New opportunities open up as you advance[/p][/*][*][p]Fresh challenges emerge to keep things engaging [/p][/*][/list][p]We want this system to feel rewarding and impactful - not just like checking boxes.[/p][h3]
[u][b]AI System[/b][/u][/h3][p]Exploration should feel alive. Our AI isn’t just about fighting or farming - it’s about creating encounters that feel purposeful and worth your time. The full system is too large to complete for Alpha, but you’ll already see the first foundations in action.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Building System[/b][/u][/h3][p]From a simple campfire to complex machines and custom homes, the building system will give you tools to create your own space in the world of G.E.T..[/p][list][*][p]Build, upgrade, and customize[/p][/*][*][p]Add furniture and decoration for personality[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][u][b]Character System[/b][/u][/h3][p]Your character is the heart of your journey. This system covers:[/p][list][*][p]Crafting[/p][/*][*][p]Items and equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Core progression features [/p][/*][/list][p]It’s all about giving you options and freedom in how you play.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Environment[/b][/u][/h3][p]The demo’s world was just a placeholder. With the Alpha, we want to give you a glimpse of the real vision:[/p][list][*][p]Distinct biomes with their own pros, cons, and challenges[/p][/*][*][p]A world that feels alive and worth exploring[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][u][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/u][/h3][p]Yes, this is a lot of work, but we’re not starting from scratch. After the demo, we kept developing and have already made solid progress. [/p][p]We’re fully committed to pushing forward with everything we’ve got. After the long break, it feels good to finally move again and we’re convinced the wait will be worth it.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]What’s Next for You[/b][/u][/h3][p]We’ll continue to keep you updated with:[/p][list][*][p]Regular text updates like this one[/p][/*][*][p]Visual sneak peeks from development[/p][/*][*][p]Opportunities to give feedback as systems take shape[/p][/*][/list][p]Your input will directly help us refine these features, because G.E.T. should be just as much your game as it is ours. Thanks for sticking with us. Onward to Alpha![/p][p][/p][p]— The G.E.T. Team[/p]
